notes.title: Life in Willowdale: Farm Adventures - Quality of Life and Content update
notes.content:
Dear villagers of Willowdale,

We have just released a new update, consisting of the frequently asked about rain feature. Now rain is no longer a bad thing, but something to celebrate!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41653163/43e828b7b33a1aaf4b52779461b29412d2627a5c.jpg

Please find the full updates note below:

 Four new crops added: Artichokes, Cranberries, Asparagus, and Beets
 New skill added: Precision Sowing
 Rain now waters your plants, no need to water them during the rain!
 Quality of life and economy fixes
 Minor bug fixes
 Minor text fixes


Four new crops have been added
Artichokes, Cranberries, Asparagus, and Beets. These seeds can be purchased from Pahi Patel’s shop. 

Precision Sowing
This newly introduced skill allows the user to plant multiple seeds at once, similar to how tools can be charged once upgraded.

Rain
Rain can occur at least once a month, excluding the winter season. If your crops are planted and haven't been watered, the rain will change their state to watered giving you time to explore the other activities in Willowdale!

This free update will be released on consoles soon as well!

notes.title: October 25th is the final release date for Steam PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5
notes.content:
Hello future villagers of Willowdale,

We are sharing a quick update regarding the release date for Life in Willowdale: Farm Adventures. We have set a final release date for October 25. Since we have unexpectedly had to move the release date we have done some additional polish and bug fixes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653163/a4c164aae8c7ba8912d72a31c5bb026ab73ddca4.png

Now it won’t be long now before you will be growing your crops, taking care of your animals, meet the villagers of Willowdale and face of in one of the four wilderness zones.

With this update we like to take the opportunity as well to tell you something about how cooperative play works in ‘Willowdale’.

Cooperative gameplay is unlocked once you finish Quest 5 ‘Advanced Tips & Tricks’ (quest name different depending on language) and you talk to the Mayor. Beyond this quest the game opens up for local cooperative play. Now, together with your BFF you will be able to take care of the crops and the animals on the farm, traverse the town and combat dangerous creatures in the wilderness zones!

To play in local co-op you need to connect two controllers.

Important to know:

 Cooperative play takes place on the same screen
 Cooperative play cannot be started on Keyboard
 Player 1 can chose to play on Keyboard once the co-op player has joined
 Disconnecting any one the two controllers will end co-op
 The user needs to connect 2 controllers for both Player 1 and Player 2 

Lastly, while the game is playable using keyboard, Life in Willowdale: Farm Adventures is best enjoyed using a controller.

Life in Willowdale: Farm Adventures is out now on Nintendo Switch and due to be released on Steam, PlayStation 4 and PlayStation coming October 25. For more information, please visit: www.lifeinwillowdale.com
